title: Coupled Motion
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Coupled motion means that moving a joint in one degree of freedom produces motion in another, without any separate effort to create it.
The six degrees of freedom described in 3.2.1 are therefore a vocabulary rather than a list of independent movements.
